changeinfo.changes:
Improvements

  • Added French as supported text language
  • Added Spanish as supported text language
  • A Mapsystem is now available in the Bookmenu
  • Hystericas Cutscenes are now skipable
  • Mining-Cart sequence with bats is now balanced
  • Other various improvements

Changes

  • Sir Eatsalot does not have to stop his motion anymore in order to regenerate once stamina is empty
  • Attack-Animation of Sir Eatsalot was changed, no impact on the hitbox, just visual

Bugfixes

  • Fixed an extremely rare bug in Choco Grotto
  • Fixed missing soundeffects
  • Fixed Input-related bug when fighting with the Black Knight
  • Fixed rare softlock when fighting Cheesebombers or Flying Rats
  • Fixed softlocks when talking to NPCs
  • Fixed bug where current level reset in a glitchy way
  • Fixed other minor bugs
